title: Check a code at the counter
summary: Check a booking ref, a drop card or a gift. Checking never uses it; confirming does.

steps.title: Open Check a code
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Check a code (staff see it as soon as they sign in). On a computer, it's in the menu on the left.

steps.title: Type or scan the code
steps.body: Type the code from the customer's phone, or scan their QR. A booking ref starts with BK-. A drop card has your two code letters, like GS-. You see what it is and whether it's ready to use, with nothing used yet.

steps.title: For a booking
steps.body: You see the service, the time, the deposit paid and what's left to collect. Tap Arrived when they come in. If someone doesn't come, the owner marks it on Calendar: tap the booking, then No-show.

steps.title: For a drop card
steps.body: Check the reward and any condition ("Only if…"), give it, then tap "Confirm redemption". That's when it's used. If the drop asks for it, check the last 6 digits of their WhatsApp number on their own phone first. You can add what they spent, or add it later.

tips: A Tikka that has run out shows who it was. Only the owner can give it more time, once, for 7 days.
